title: East Geelvink Bay languages - Wikipedia
text: The East Geelvink Bay or East Cenderawasih languages are a language family of a dozen Papuan languages along the eastern coast of Geelvink Bay in Indonesian Papua, which is also known as Sarera Bay or Cenderawasih.

title: Burate language
text: Linguistic evidence further links Burate to the East Geelvink Bay group through shared pronominal forms and basic vocabulary. These correspondences indicate a common ancestral stage for the family, distinct from neighboring Papuan groups.
